data.narrative:
SwarmFarm Robotics is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company that has raised AU$30M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparison universe of nine private peers and one public comparable, all operating within the robotics and manufacturing sector at similar or analogous stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the AU$30M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding an implied valuation of AU$57M. Peer-median analysis examines three same-sector, same-stage comparables—Generalist AI ($2.0B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B), and Dexterity ($1.6B)—establishing a median valuation of $1.75B with a range of $1.6B to $2.0B.

The two methods produce a wide triangulated range: low of $48M, median of $904M, and high of $2.0B. This dispersion reflects material asymmetry between capital-based valuation progression and peer-market multiples in an active but volatile sector. The peer-median method carries greater weight given the specificity of same-stage comparables, but execution risk, revenue traction, and relative market position remain critical drivers of where within this range—or beyond it—SwarmFarm's true valuation settles. Uncertainty is substantial and warrants primary due diligence on unit economics and customer pipeline depth.
